source: This is why “the tensor fits in ZXNAME0000XZ memory” says almost nothing about kernel performance. Capacity tells us whether data can reside somewhere in the memory system. Performance depends on how often data moves, how much reuse is captured on chip, and whether the working set and access pattern match the hardware.
zh: 这就是为什么“张量适合 ZXNAME0000XZ 内存”几乎没有提到内核性能。容量告诉我们数据是否可以驻留在内存系统中的某个位置。性能取决于数据移动的频率、芯片上捕获的重用程度以及工作集和访问模式是否与硬件匹配。
